as_told.title: Philadelphia Experiment
as_told.place_text: Philadelphia Navy Yard to Norfolk, Virginia

related.note: Both are about the Philadelphia Experiment. This telling says it really happened in Rhode Island and Philadelphia was the cover story, while the story calls the Philadelphia-to-Norfolk teleportation a bogus disinformation campaign.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up the Philadelphia Experiment, a story from the 1940s that says a Navy ship and its crew were teleported from Philadelphia to a port in Norfolk, Virginia. Michels himself calls it a clearly false story spread on purpose to mislead people, and he mentions it alongside a man named Townsend Brown. He tells it as an example of how the UFO subject has been muddied with planted tales.
